scope: Two separate offline prompt variants: E1 changes one demonstration; S1 adds one framing distinction. Neither combines both changes.
self_review_question: 这个修改是否有具体依据帮助模型提高判断正确性，同时避免把原本正确的句子带偏？
review_author: AI analysis; not a measured improvement or human annotation

review.observed_gap: 原第15条金额示例缺少具体数值；当前22-shot仍会把抵减关系等状态描述判成义务。
review.reason_to_change: 用train原标签为definition、抵减关系谓词完整的例句补足现有算术示例的教学内容；不改变总数、类别数量或其他21条。
review.regression_risk: 可能把真正要求执行计算的obligation也吸收到definition；保留原有义务示例，后续检查反向误判。
review.decision: apply only this D-to-D replacement; no claim of performance improvement

S1.before:
to perform or omit conduct, and an option offered to a subject. A verb-first
   German segment can be a conditional antecedent even without "wenn".
S1.after:
to perform or omit conduct, and an option offered to a subject.
   An introduction such as "gilt Folgendes" points to the following content;
   classify that content instead of making the introduction a separate rule.
   A complete assertion such as "die Vorschrift gilt entsprechend" can state
   applicability on its own. Decide from the complete construction. A verb-first
   German segment can be a conditional antecedent even without "wenn".

review.observed_gap: 当前22-shot有引导语被单列为definition、后续许可因首标签取值被丢掉的返回；现有指引说明条件句，但没有明确区分引导下文与独立适用声明。
review.reason_to_change: 只补这个具体语义区别，帮助保留真正主断言；配一个完整适用声明的对照，避免把所有gilt结构都当引导语。
review.regression_risk: 可能误合并独立适用声明；保留该反例和原有独立clause按原文顺序输出的规则。
review.decision: apply only the framing clarification; do not change genuine multi-proposition readout
